decisions: Any two distinct declared platforms, including linux+macos, require pwsh. This is the simpler rule and matches the stated BSD/GNU portability problem.
platforms is always shared-only, while shell overrides are refused only for a mixed team. The literal error messages and config-set exit codes are appropriate.
Shared-only errors apply wherever the config is read; an accepted plan retains its recorded shell and is not re-linted if platforms is added later. This preserves C-1 and P-5.

Gate portability is enforced by a fixed driver list plus skill guidance; vloop task verify, existing plans, and non-.ps1 gate scripts remain outside the lint. This is a deliberate, bounded enforcement surface.
A missing pwsh is a mixed-team problem only when no plan is in use, while the checks' implicit-shell condition remains a warning. This preserves upgrades for single-OS repositories.
